name: bewitch Linux Server Monitor
free_limit: Apache-2.0 licensed Linux server monitoring daemon and terminal UI with local DuckDB metrics history, hardware health checks, alerts and SQL console; self-managed software with no vendor-imposed usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Free software only, not free VPS or hosted monitoring. Requires your own Linux server and storage; alert delivery and remote access require configuration. Runs a per-machine daemon rather than a centralized hosted service. Review security and production suitability before installation.
